item.title: BlickPix 1.2
item.description:
• A new hover toolbar, in four styles to choose from in Settings → General → Toolbar: Capsule, Corners, Scrim and Rail. It stays readable on bright photos and adds Rotate, Flip, Info and Share buttons.
  • BlickPix now updates itself: it checks for new versions about once a day, or choose BlickPix → Check for Updates….
  • Also new since 1.0: Move to Trash (⌘⌫), Copy (⌘C), Share, full screen (F), an info panel with camera and lens details (I), Flip (H / V), Undo (⌘Z), Save Rotation (⌘S), File → Open Recent, and folders that follow changes made in other apps.
